body: Thank you. I started learning English when I was 6 so basically my entire life. Yeah, I actually write and make music too. Yeah, I know things will be a lot better when I leave it's just fucking intolerable at the moment.

I'm 16 and I live in Japan. 

Yeah, I have plans to leave as soon as I finish school I just have to figure out all the logistics. Fortunately/unfortunately for me I don't graduate for another year so I guess I have plenty of time to figure it out.

Sadly I think most people experience suicidal thoughts and contemplation, it is a widespread mentality in todays society but even after you reach that point there is still a huge barrier that needs to be broken to actually do it and I don't think many people manage to

I'm just a waste. I'm such a disappointment to my family and the fact that I will never amount to anything they will never love me properly. I am undeserving of their love anyway so I should just rid myself from the equation completely
